hook.name: LendingHookV3
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a range-aware lending AMM. It seeds the pool with single-sided liquidity across discrete tick bands and charges a 1% fee on all swaps (buy fees via BeforeSwapDelta in beforeSwap, sell fees via afterSwap delta). Also supports ETH-backed borrowing with band-specific liquidation that recycles collateral back as pool liquidity.
